$comment: Fixtures for the framework's own i18n suite.
These used to be an application's message bundles, reached through the test
runner's /i18n/ mount. That made the library suite fail the moment a second
application became the one under test, which is the rule source/lib/test
states about itself: nothing here may need an application to pass.
Whether a given application's bundles are complete is checked by
`npm run verify`, and whether its screens read correctly is that
application's own smoke test. Neither is this file's job.
